topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I can't believe I’m the one to tell you this, but I saw something today that just wouldn’t let me rest. I was out, grabbing coffee, and I swear, there was this person with your artwork inked right on their arm. I know you pour your heart into every brushstroke, and to see it… permanently on someone’s skin… I’m not sure how you’ll take it. I hope it doesn’t ruin what you feel about your art, but I had to let you know. I’m here, no matter what you need.
